'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Chris Menzel LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
